requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6K Black and 6K CMY page yield, with CMY bottle size supporting >8K pages.
requirements.Rationale: To meet higher page yield expectations and reduce customer intervention, aligning with market needs for higher efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle design, manufacturing changes, and compatibility with current system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NGB bottles are available in specified capacities, tested to deliver the stated page yields without failure.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Ensure ink bottle design and system integration achieve spill-free refilling and operation.
requirements.Rationale: To improve user experience, reduce mess, and enhance product reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Refill process is tested in 100 cycles with zero spills or leaks reported.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F with a metal foiled labyrinth and a lid label, maintaining current click on push-push and TDF mechanisms.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances reliability and tamper-evidence for service parts.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires sourcing of metal foiled components and label design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes tamper and reliability tests and is compatible with existing push-push and TDF mechanisms.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Enable end users to replace Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components themselves without service center intervention.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability and reduces downtime/cost for users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires user-friendly design and supporting documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes following provided instructions.

requirements.Title: Warranty Page Life Goal of 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Design the printer and consumables to support a minimum warranty page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with new warranty and reliability standards to reduce service costs and improve customer satisfaction.
requirements.Stakeholders: Quality Assurance, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Impacts component durability and consumable design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: System passes internal durability and page life tests up to 80K pages without major failure.

requirements.Title: Support for New EPS Foam Packaging
requirements.Description: Implement EPS foam packaging for the product to improve protection during shipping and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces damage during transit, enhancing product quality perception and reducing returns.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires packaging design updates and supply chain adjustments.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Packaging passes drop and vibration tests per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Compliance with EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel for PDL SKU
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certification requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Required for market acceptance in regulated regions and for environmental compliance.
requirements.Dependencies: Certification process and documentation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product receives EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications prior to launch.

requirements.Title: Input and Output Tray Changes for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to accommodate changes in printer size due to tank protrusion.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures mechanical compatibility and user convenience with enlarged tanks.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on final tank design dimensions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays fit seamlessly with the protruding tank and pass usability and durability tests.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch CGD (color graphical display) into the printer UI.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user interaction and accessibility, supporting modern UI expectations.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, UI/UX Team, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires hardware and software integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Display is fully functional, responsive, and passes user acceptance testing.

requirements.Title: New Tube Routing and Integration
requirements.Description: Leverage Sayan Sibstar tubes with new routing and integration for the tank system.
requirements.Rationale: Supports increased page life and reliability with optimized ink delivery.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires mechanical design updates and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Tube system passes reliability and flow rate tests under all operating conditions.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Update service station with aerosol management and spit platform changes to accommodate new tank design.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents ink aerosol buildup and maintains print quality and reliability.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires changes to service station design and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol levels remain within HP safety and quality thresholds during extended operation.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Support for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Redesign paper path components to support higher page life (up to 80K pages).
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent performance and durability over extended use.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires component material and design updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path components pass durability tests for 80K pages without significant wear.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80K Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components to be serviceable by service centers after 80K page life is reached.
requirements.Rationale: Extends product lifecycle and reduces total cost of ownership for customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires service documentation and spare part logistics.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Service centers can replace ink maintenance parts within 30 minutes following provided procedures.

requirements.Title: 140ml Black and New CMY Bottle Sizes
requirements.Description: Introduce 140ml K (black) bottles and new, larger CMY bottle sizes for extended page yield.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces refill frequency and supports higher page yield targets.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires bottle manufacturing and supply chain updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New bottles are available at launch and validated for compatibility and yield.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop new IDS (Ink Delivery System) startup algorithm and air management system to optimize reliability and startup performance.
requirements.Rationale: Improves startup reliability and prevents air-related failures in the ink delivery system.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and mechanical system updates.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Startup success rate exceeds 99% in validation testing.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Model
requirements.Description: Establish new print quality (PQ) goals and depletion model to align with page yield definitions and customer expectations.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures consistent print quality throughout the consumable lifecycle.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires updates to firmware and consumable tracking.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ remains within specified tolerances for the entire page yield period.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU hardware components in the new product design.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development cost and time by reusing proven components.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility validation with new system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Hardware components function correctly in the new system without modification.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module for wireless connectivity in the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets modern connectivity expectations for SMB and enterprise environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires firmware and hardware integration.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi module passes connectivity and throughput tests per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Implementation (HW & FW)
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures product meets HP and industry security standards for data protection.
requirements.Stakeholders: IT Security, Product Management, Enterprise Customers
requirements.Dependencies: Requires coordination between hardware and firmware teams.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product passes all internal and external security certification tests.

requirements.Title: SMB Solution and Manageability Support
requirements.Description: Provide SMB manageability features and solutions, including scan solution and enterprise support (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses needs of SMB and enterprise customers for device management and integration.
requirements.Stakeholders: SMB Customers, Enterprise IT, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires software development and integration with HP management tools.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product is compatible with WJA, HPSM, JAM and passes manageability acceptance tests.

requirements.Title: PaaS (Printing as a Service) Enablement
requirements.Description: Support for PaaS business model, including onboarding paths for Consumer, HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, and ECP.
requirements.Rationale: Enables flexible business models and service offerings for different customer segments.
requirements.Stakeholders: Business Development, Product Management, End Users
requirements.Dependencies: Requires integration with HP service platforms.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Onboarding process is functional and validated for all specified customer paths.

requirements.Title: Throughput of 25/20 PPM (PDL: 25/19 PPM)
requirements.Description: Achieve print throughput of 25/20 pages per minute (PDL: 25/19 ppm) for the product.
requirements.Rationale: Meets competitive benchmarks and customer productivity needs.
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on hardware, firmware, and ink system performance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves specified throughput in standard print tests.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Pages
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Printhead Assembly life is at least 65,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Supports high reliability and reduced maintenance for end users.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durable printhead design and validation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65K page life testing without failure.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 2 Years or 80K Pages
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 2 years or 80,000 pages, whichever comes first.
requirements.Rationale: Provides clear and competitive warranty terms to customers.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Quality Assurance, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Depends on product reliability and support infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty documentation and support processes are in place and communicated to customers.

requirements.Title: Serviceability via Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a maintenance box in the design to support easy serviceability and replacement.
requirements.Rationale: Facilitates routine maintenance and prolongs device life.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires design and documentation for maintenance box replacement.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced in under 10 minutes following the provided instructions.
